name: Room Additions
summary: Residential room additions planned to expand living space with coordinated foundations, framing, roofing, insulation, drywall, electrical, plumbing and interior finishes.

faqs.question: Do room additions require permits?
faqs.answer: Most room additions require plans, permits and inspections. Requirements depend on the city, project size, structure and utility work involved.

faqs.question: Can an addition match the existing home?
faqs.answer: The design can coordinate rooflines, exterior materials, trim, flooring, paint and interior finishes to create a consistent transition.
